notes:
JAPANESE FAST FOOD:
{牛丼|ぎゅうどん} is one of Japan's most popular fast food dishes. Major chains like {吉野家|よしのや}, すき{家|や}, and {松屋|まつや} serve it nationwide at affordable prices.
